description: Added credential and shell-command risks are located precisely; an adjacent pure function is a negative control.
notes: CM_FIXTURE_CREDENTIAL_7a9b2c4d6e8f is an invented, nonfunctional marker. It is intentionally shaped as a literal credential assignment to test recognition without using a real key.
The fixture is parsed, never imported or executed. os.system is an external call and therefore not a repository edge.
Risk ground truth is a review warning about accepting a command string, not a claim of an exploitable deployed application.
